notes: Pass 1: buildertrend.com answered HTTP 403 (blocked at the edge) to the first two requests, home and pricing; under the 8 Oct clarification no further request was made to that host. CoConstruct's own prices (for example ~$449/mo) and features were treated as statements about another product and not coded. Hedged lines were coded only where the fact itself is stated without a hedge, for example the '~$399/mo' table cell rather than the hedged sentence. Training programmes (Buildertrend University, Learning Academy) and generic feature labels were not coded as product names. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the six pages in needs_browser_read were each read once in a real browser and re-classed against: C01, C05, C06, C07, C38, C39 and C50 are now true; every other claim stays unverifiable. The FAQ snapshot carries the questions only (answers collapsed), so free trial, data storage, mobile use, plan inclusions and how pricing is determined remain unsettled. The pricing guide's comparison table has an unlabelled logo column; it is read as Buildertrend's because its pricing model is 'Custom quote; all-in-one', matching the 'Custom plans (Buildertrend)' text above it, and its founding year (2006) is not claimed by any answer. Reviewer: C09 (tiered pricing) and C08 (flat monthly fee) were considered for wrong against that table ('Custom quote; all-in-one' vs competitors' 'Tiered'; payment options 'Annual or quarterly') and left unverifiable because the pricing page also offers 'different options' and the plan FAQ is collapsed; C37 ('Sub Center') is unverifiable though the pages label the feature 'Sub Portal'. Gaps and tables: every uncovered line with a Buildertrend fact is already an instance from the same answer (C01, C02, C08, C10, C12, C14, C31, C36, C38, C39, C50) or is out of scope (fit, positioning, features, other vendors), so no claim or instance was added. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Still needed for the integrations (C40 to C44) and the CoConstruct acquisition (C47 to C49): an integrations page and a company or press page; buildertrend.com/buildertrend-vs-procore/, cited by ten answers, may also settle plan and pricing claims.
